_meta.description: Vietnam administrative divisions (post-2025 reform, 2-tier) for the SOMS customer/site address picker.
_meta.note: The 2025 reform (effective 2025-07-01) abolished the district level (Quận/Huyện) nationwide. Structure is now 2-tier: Tỉnh/Thành phố (province) → Phường/Xã (ward/commune). 34 provinces, 3,320 wards. Province Korean/English names are curated locally; ward names + GSO codes are sourced from github.com/zuydd/vn-geo (National Statistics Office data). The picker keeps a free-text fallback for any unlisted entry.
